# 🏁 XNFS Playlist Builder 3.2 Beta 1.7 | Gameplay feedback

Welcome! This version focuses on **large soundtracks, better installation feedback and Windows upgrade reliability** for Need for Speed Most Wanted (2005) and Carbon (2006).

**Download after publication:** https://github.com/ValentineBSAA/XNFS-Playlist-Builder-/releases

Developer **valentine** reports successful actual gameplay with **45 custom interactive Pursuit songs, 45 Safe House songs and 45 Free Roam songs** in Most Wanted. The new live audio-preparation percentage worked in the 45-song pursuit install, and the installation completed. Other upgrades include named post-audio stages, a completion review that returns to the workspace and an embedded Windows application icon.

**Developer-verified audio setting:** adjust **Car Volume manually in Most Wanted's own Audio options**. The builder's independent music setting does **not** change engine sound. This is normal usage, not an untested feature.

**What could use more reports:** Carbon 1.4 gameplay; Canyon/Pursuit/Drift event audio; PLAK/modified game compatibility; Most Wanted's first song after switching saves and revised custom-score exit fade. Independent custom Carbon Canyon/Pursuit song pools are not yet implemented, and the intermittent Carbon Load Complete crash has no confirmed fix.

Tell us **which game/executable, which music mode, and what worked or didn't**. Even a short real-game test helps.

For a reproducible issue, use [the bug report form](https://github.com/ValentineBSAA/XNFS-Playlist-Builder-/issues/new/choose). Support can save a local ZIP containing Plain English and JSON diagnostics; it does not send it automatically. Review extra logs and screenshots for personal details before attaching.

**Testing details:** https://github.com/ValentineBSAA/XNFS-Playlist-Builder-/blob/main/docs/WHATS-NEW-BETA-1.7.md

Thanks for giving your soundtrack the road time. 🎵
